scope: Release notice only; no farming/course instruction. Also supplies missing exact source pairs for the preceding boundary/terrain notice.

entries.english: Choose Editorial Atlas for a lighter AI style and a circular Sector diagram.
entries.zu: Khetha i-Editorial Atlas ukuze uthole isitayela se-AI esilula nomdwebo oyindilinga weSector.
entries.st: Kgetha Editorial Atlas bakeng sa setaele sa AI se bobebe le setshwantsho se chitja sa Sector.
entries.ts: Hlawula Editorial Atlas ku kuma xitayili xa AI lexi vevukaka ni xifaniso xa xirhendzevutana xa Sector.
entries.ve: Nangani Editorial Atlas u wana tshitaela tsha AI tshi leluwaho na tshifanyiso tsha Sector tsha tshitendeledzi.

entries.english: Maps have finer boundaries with round posts and clearer Earthworks labels.
entries.zu: Amamephu anemingcele emincane enezigxobo eziyindilinga namalebula e-Earthworks acace kakhudlwana.
entries.st: Limmapa di na le meedi e mesesane e nang le dipalo tse chitja le mabitso a hlakileng a Earthworks.
entries.ts: Mimepe yi ni mindzilakana yo lala leyi nga ni tiphuphu ta xirhendzevutana ni malebulu ya Earthworks lama nga erivaleni swinene.
entries.ve: Mimepe i na mikano misekene i re na thanda dza tshitendeledzi na malebulu a Earthworks a re khagala nga u engedza.

entries.english: Terrain maps show elevation, slope percentage and degrees from local terrain data.
entries.zu: Amamephu omhlaba abonisa ukuphakama, iphesenti lomthambeka namadigri athathwe kudatha yomhlaba yendawo.
entries.st: Limmapa tsa sebaka di bontsha bophahamo, peresente ya moepa le dikerii tse tswang ho data ya sebaka seo.
entries.ts: Mimepe ya misava yi komba ku tlakuka, phesente ya ku voyama ni tidigirii leswi humaka eka datha ya misava ya ndhawu.
entries.ve: Mimepe ya mavu i sumbedza vhulapfu, phesenthe ya mutevhe na digirii zwi bvaho kha data ya mavu a henefho.
